in_hebrew.name: Liberty
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Freedom from oppression
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Liberty הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Latin word 'liber', meaning 'free'. The name Liberty represents freedom from oppression, tyranny, or bondage. It is a symbol of hope, courage, and resilience, reminding us to stand up for our rights and values.
